dialogues.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
dialogues.text: I've heard that some animals can ferment food in their stomachs to prepare it for eating. If I do the fermenting for them, then it should save them some effort. Genius idea, huh?

choices.text: You'd better have a proper theoretical basis for this...

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: Haha, of course I don't! But a chef's intuition can't possibly be wrong — not when it comes to preparing food.

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: And sure, I've been getting a lot of complaints because the flavor isn't quite right. But if you let fear of criticism stop you from trying new things, then you'll never make any progress.

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: If I get it wrong this time, you can call me every name under the sun. I won't shy away from criticism!

choices.text: Just try not to produce any hazardous chemicals...

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: Of course! I conduct all my experiments in a sealed environment. If they let off any noxious gases, I'll be the first to feel the effects...

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: Once I come to, I'll make sure to destroy the lot. That way, there'll be no risk of wider contamination!

choices.text: You might need to consider the cost...

response.speaker: Captain Ferment O'Juice
response.text: Don't worry about that — when it comes to experiments like this, I pay out of my own pocket!
